open_points.subject: A6 rule 1 and Model M08
open_points.text: A6 says the delivery "is refused as a whole request with the UNSAFE_REFERENCE member of = models.RefusalCode, an M08", while M08 says: "A delivery is M08 for the refusals of A3 rule 4 and A6 rule 5, and M06 for the failures of A3 rule 5."
open_points.question: Is the unsafe-reference refusal of A6 rule 1 an M08, and must M08's exhaustive description include A6 rule 1?
options: It is an M08 and the M08 description must include A6 rule 1
It is an M06 failed-photo outcome
A third answer model is intended
open_points.default_guess: Treat it as M08 and add A6 rule 1 to M08's description.

witness.initial: A valid request has no existing placement, but the computed stored-image reference resolves outside the binary store.
events: The service reaches the stored-reference containment check.
outcomes: A6 rule 1 returns M08 with UNSAFE_REFERENCE.
The current M08 definition does not classify A6 rule 1 as an M08, so an implementation rejects that response classification or chooses another outcome.
witness.observer: The caller and generated response validator

open_points.subject: A3 rule 5 and A5 rule 8
open_points.text: "A refusal of the whole request under A5 or A6, an M08, is not a failed photo." A5 rule 8 also says that when a folder on the checked source path has been replaced, "the delivery fails under condition 1 of A3 rule 5."
open_points.question: Which A5-described failures are whole-request M08 refusals, and which are M06 failures under A3 rule 5 condition 1?
options: Only failures before the named-file phase are A5 whole-request refusals; failures while walking the requested name are A3 condition-1 failures
Every failure governed by A5 is an M08
Classify particular A5 conditions explicitly
open_points.default_guess: Use the operation order: failure of the project photo folder before the lock is M08, while failure in the folders of the requested name is M06 NOT_READY_OR_ABSENT.

witness.initial: The project photo folder passed the initial A5 containment check; afterward, an intermediate folder in the requested name is replaced by a symbolic link.
events: The service walks the requested name without following links and encounters the replacement.
outcomes: A5 rule 8 and A3 condition 1 produce M06 with NOT_READY_OR_ABSENT.
The new blanket reference to a refusal under A5 is read as producing M08.

open_points.subject: A6 rule 1 and A6 rule 4
open_points.text: A6 rule 1 says an unsafe or unresolvable reference is refused and "nothing is written." A6 rule 4 says the project lock "is created on first use" and its first creation "is the only write of an operation that writes nothing else." A3 rule 4 orders the project lock before the existing-placement and named-file checks.
open_points.question: May an unsafe-reference refusal create the project lock, or must the containment check occur before the lock so that literally nothing is written?
options: The refusal may create only the project lock
The unsafe-reference check occurs before lock acquisition and writes nothing
The lock must already exist or the request is refused differently
open_points.default_guess: Permit the project lock as the same explicit exception allowed for A3 failure conditions, and change "nothing is written" accordingly.

witness.initial: The project has no lock file and its prospective stored-image path is unsafe or cannot be resolved.
events: The caller requests its first delivery for the project.
The service follows A3's order and creates/acquires the project lock.
outcomes: Following A3 and A6 rule 4 leaves the newly created project lock.
Following A6 rule 1 literally leaves no new file or folder.
witness.observer: The operator inspecting the state folder and a test asserting durable writes

open_points.subject: A6 rule 1
open_points.text: The rule says refusal also occurs "when the path cannot be resolved", then says: "the refusal is reachable only when a folder of the store is a link that leads out of it."
open_points.question: Can inability to resolve the path independently cause UNSAFE_REFERENCE, or is a link leading outside the store the only reachable cause?
options: Every resolution failure causes UNSAFE_REFERENCE
Only a resolved link escape causes UNSAFE_REFERENCE
Resolution failures are divided into explicitly named cases
open_points.default_guess: Treat every resolution failure as UNSAFE_REFERENCE and remove the claim that only an outward link makes the refusal reachable.

witness.initial: The binary store exists, but a required folder in the prospective stored-image path is absent or otherwise cannot be resolved; no folder is a link leading outside.
events: The caller requests a new placement.
The service checks the prospective stored-image reference.
outcomes: The explicit resolution-failure clause returns M08 UNSAFE_REFERENCE.
The reachability sentence implies that this case cannot cause the refusal and the service proceeds to create folders or fails by another rule.

open_points.subject: A6 rule 1
open_points.text: "its path, resolved with the links of the binary store, must lie below the resolved store; otherwise, and also when the path cannot be resolved"
open_points.question: How is the path of a new stored image resolved when the image and possibly its project folder do not exist yet: resolve the complete prospective path, resolve its nearest existing ancestor, or create folders before checking?
options: Resolve and check the nearest existing ancestor, then validate every newly created segment without following links
Create the project folder and then resolve the complete parent path
Require every parent folder to pre-exist
Use a lexical containment check in addition to resolving the store
open_points.default_guess: Resolve the store and nearest existing ancestor, then create and open missing folders relative to already opened safe directories without following links.

witness.initial: The binary store exists and is safe, but this project has never delivered a photo, so `photos/<project_id>` and the target JPEG do not exist.
events: The caller requests the first placement for the project.
The service evaluates the requirement that the target path be resolved.
outcomes: An implementation treats the nonexistent target as unresolvable and refuses with UNSAFE_REFERENCE.
Another resolves the existing parent, creates the missing safe folders, and completes the placement.

open_points.subject: A3 replay and A6 stored-reference containment
open_points.text: A3 rule 4 orders "project lock, existing placement, named file", while A6 rule 1 says: "The reference must stay inside the binary store" and otherwise "the delivery is refused as a whole request".
open_points.question: Must a replay validate the stored placement's `file_ref` against A6 rule 1 before returning it, or does finding the existing placement return `replayed` without the containment check?
options: Validate containment on both new placements and replays
Validate containment only before writing a new stored image
Validate the stored record's reference as part of record validation under A6 rule 5
open_points.default_guess: Validate the stored reference inside the project lock before returning a replay, and return M08 UNSAFE_REFERENCE if it is unsafe.

witness.initial: A valid placement record already exists, but its stored-image reference now resolves outside the binary store or cannot be resolved.
events: The caller repeats delivery with the same project and source id.
The service finds the existing placement before examining the named file.
outcomes: The service immediately returns REPLAYED with the stored placement.
The service applies A6 rule 1 and returns M08 UNSAFE_REFERENCE.

open_points.subject: A3 rule 4 request-form and project-id refusals
open_points.text: "A defect of that form or of the project id is refused as a whole request."
open_points.question: What response and RefusalCode are returned for a malformed body, a body with extra or missing fields, a non-string field, or a non-UUID project id?
options: M08 with new explicit refusal codes
A protocol/framework validation response outside M08
M08 with one existing RefusalCode, identified explicitly
open_points.default_guess: Use a protocol validation response outside M08, because none of the closed RefusalCode members describes an invalid body or project id.

witness.initial: The caller is authenticated and sends a body whose `name` is not a string.
events: The service performs the request-form check before the connection check.
outcomes: The implementation returns its framework's validation response.
The implementation tries to return M08 but must invent or reuse a RefusalCode not assigned by the text.

open_points.subject: Model M07 PublicationMark
open_points.question: What source supplies `marked_at`, what instant does it denote, what datetime representation and timezone does it use, and how many readings does one mark operation take?
options: Read an injected system clock once when the mark is created and store naive UTC
Read an injected system clock once and store timezone-aware UTC
Receive the publication instant from the caller
Use the Portal response time or another declared authority
open_points.default_guess: Read an injected system clock exactly once when creating the first mark and store naive UTC, matching the product's other persisted UTC datetimes.

witness.initial: A placement exists and has no publication mark.
outcomes: One implementation stores a naive UTC value from its system clock.
Another stores an aware local-time value, reads the clock more than once, or accepts the caller's time.
witness.observer: A later replay, record reader, or test comparing `marked_at`

open_points.subject: INV-02 Required tests
open_points.text: "INV-02: for content with no placement, an empty or absolute name, a name with an empty, `.` or `..` segment, an ignored name at any level, a folder, and a path through a symbolic link each fail with the NOT_READY_OR_ABSENT member of = models.PlacementFailure and add no file except the project lock (`test_a_name_a_scan_would_not_report_is_not_delivered`)."
open_points.question: What must the test observe to show the invariant that the delivery opens no path failing condition 1, rather than merely showing the returned failure and durable writes?
options: Instrument path-opening calls and assert that no forbidden target or descendant is opened
Restate INV-02 as an outcome-and-write invariant matching the described test
Add a filesystem witness that detects any forbidden open
open_points.default_guess: Instrument the filesystem/open boundary and assert that the rejected segment and anything below it are never opened.

open_points.subject: INV-19 Required tests
open_points.text: "INV-19: delivering content that has no placement under the name of a conflict copy fails with the NOT_READY_OR_ABSENT member of = models.PlacementFailure, adds no file except the project lock and changes no existing file (`test_a_syncthing_conflict_copy_is_neither_offered_nor_placed`)."
open_points.question: What must the test observe to show that a new placement never reads a conflict copy, rather than only showing its answer and final durable state?
options: Instrument file opening and reading and assert that the conflict copy is never opened or read
Restate INV-19 as an outcome-and-write invariant matching the described test
Use a conflict-copy file whose read would produce a detectable failure or side effect
open_points.default_guess: Instrument the source-file open/read boundary and assert zero opens and reads of the conflict copy.

open_points.subject: A3 rule 5
open_points.text:
Otherwise, a photo that cannot be delivered is answered with status `failed` and one member of
   `= models.PlacementFailure`.
open_points.rule:
Член перечисления note называет его именем рядом с адресом перечисления:
`the EXPENSE_CREATE member of = models.AuditAction`.
open_points.question: Replace the value-only status `failed` with the generated member name beside its model address, for example `the FAILED member of = models.PlacementStatus`.
